topic: Reliable ecosystem field input and clean Run 1 playtest
currentUserGoal: Stop valid grass touches from being dropped and leave the ecosystem playtest on a genuinely clean first run instead of opening in Memory Grove.
workCompleted: Found the recurring missed-touch bug in the Phaser input geometry: the field surface was made interactive while it was still 1x1, and later visual resizing did not resize Phaser's frozen hit area.
Added an explicit hit-area resize helper and now synchronize the real rectangular input area whenever the visible field surface is laid out.
Replaced the scene's single shared pointer gesture with a per-pointer registry so overlapping or rapid pointer sequences cannot overwrite one another.
Exposed field surface and hit-area dimensions plus active pointer gesture count in the ecosystem harness for repeatable regression checks.
Added focused regression tests for resized Phaser hit areas and independent simultaneous pointer gestures.
Cleared the prototype save and reopened the playtest on active Run 1 with 100 HP, 0 RT, 0 GT, one tile, no Memories, and zero prior touch attempts.
verificationRun: npm run check passed: ESLint, 172 Vitest tests across 21 files, strict TypeScript, and the Vite production build.
The focused EcosystemFieldInput suite passed all 7 tests.
A live pointer click near the edge of the visible one-tile field registered one attempt and one accepted touch, proving the input is no longer limited to the original 1x1 hit area.
After the live regression click, the prototype was reset again and reopened as a clean active Run 1.
The final live harness reported a 716x522 visible field surface and a matching 716x522 hit area, zero active gestures, zero attempts, and approximately 144 FPS in the sampled desktop window.
The final browser console contained no warnings or errors.
git diff --check passed apart from the repository's existing Windows LF-to-CRLF notices.

gitStatus.expectedAfterCommit: Field input reliability checkpoint committed locally; master is five commits ahead of origin/master and has not been pushed.

knownIssues: The selected in-app browser exposes no viewport override capability, so this focused slice could not repeat the live interaction check at an exact 390x844 viewport.
The intentionally lethal fresh Run 1 ends on the first accepted touch; this is authored balance and was kept separate from the input regression.
Chicken Patrol and later helper chapters remain functional scaffolding rather than guided animated chapters.
nextRecommendedSteps: Hands-on spam-click the clean one-tile Run 1 and confirm every off-cooldown press now gives immediate visual and audio feedback.
Repeat the edge-click regression at a 390x844 phone viewport when a browser with responsive viewport control is available.
Continue progression feel testing from the clean first collapse into Tiny Sprinkler unlock and Run 2.
Design the first unusual Tiny Sprinkler and Field Mouse synergy after input reliability is approved.
Push local master only when the user requests a GitHub, production, or Mac sync.
doNotRevert: Do not remove explicit field hit-area synchronization; Phaser does not resize an existing hit area when GameObject.setSize is called.
Do not restore one shared drag gesture for all pointers.
Do not change the approved fresh Run 1 pacing while investigating input handling.
Do not cite the legacy 1200-tile harness as ecosystem performance evidence.
Do not touch docs/CODEX_GITHUB_SETUP_GUIDE.md without explicit user direction.
